svg.title: Richer full-screen views for every widget type
svg.desc: Four illustrative expanded views. Calendar shows four complete weeks and highlighted-day event and availability details, Rain shows amount bars and an aligned probability strip, air quality adds labeled sample history, and Favorites shows more apps with full names. Each has Restore dashboard and Back navigation.
svg.text: Every widget: additional information in full screen
OK → shell + 140 ms zoom (92% → 100%) → richer content · Back restores · Reduced motion skips zoom

g.text: Calendar · Four whole weeks + day detail
Offline · Full-screen weeks leave compact ranges intact
Bar height = amount · Strip = chance · Same hour
Selected-day hours · Actual coverage · Source · Update
Air quality · Nearby station map + history
Nearby map / History · 24 hours / 7 days / 30 days
Your actual location + nearby readings · Attribution visible
Back → Dashboard · OK → Launch selected app

svg.text: Required for every future widget: useful extra information + consistent restore behavior + acceptance checks.
